book.name: Maak
book.title: Pwoo ɗeret nKaa Jesu Kristi Ɗe Maak

content: Kám Kǝ Nen MǝyiiMǝ Nen Yahudi Mo
Nen Farisi mo, kǝ pak nenkám Wàar Mosis mo, ɗe mo tong nJerusalem, mo jì kuur pee Jesu ɗi.
Ɓe mo naa pak jeplep Jesu moo se mbiise shi sar ɗe baa nǝ ɓang kas, shii kǝ mǝnǝ nǝ, baa mo vwang sar fur mo kaaɗi nen Farisi mo sat nnǝ, mo cìn sǝ kas.
Baa nen Farisi mo kǝ nen Yahudi mo jir, moo see mbiise kas, see mo shee vwang sar fur mo rǝret akuɗang. Moo tap aa mbii ɗe gyet mǝyii fur moo loot kǝ cìn nǝ.

Katɗang mo tong nlutuk jì, ɓe baa mon nse mee mbii kas, see mo shee vwang sut rǝret akuɗang. Pak mbii mo ɗǝɗes, ɗe moo cìn, ɗe mo kám a pǝ nen mǝyii fur mo, kaa vwang laaɗaa mo, kǝ tuul mo, kǝ ɗaa bòng mo sǝ.
Nen Farisi mo, kǝ nenkám Wàar nMosis mo tal pǝ Jesu nǝnee, <<A me le ɗangɓe baa jeplep fwaa moo tap kǝ kám kǝ nen mǝyii funu mo kas ye? Har moo se mbiise shi sar ɗe baa mo ɓang kas.>>
Jesu lap mmo nǝnee, <<Wun nen mwaan ndang Naan shi pǝtuup vǝl-vǝl mo. Gyet Aizaya wur satpwoo nkaa wun azeen nǝnee,

content.text: <Nen ɗesǝ moo shin ɗeɗes nghan a shi

content: Wuu yit Wàar Naan, kǝ wu ɗyel a Wàar ɗe gurum moo loot kǝ cìn nǝ.>>
Wur sat mmo zak nǝnee, <<Wun kǝ mee ar seen mbe cii Wàar Naan mo, mbǝkǝ wu ɗyel kám fuu mo ɗe.
Mosis sat nǝnee, <A shin ɗeɗes mpuun fwaa kǝ nǝǝn fwaa,> Kǝzak nǝnee, <gwar ɗewur satpwoo ɗebish nkaa puun koo nǝǝn wur, ɓe mon ntu wur ating.>
Amma wuu kám ngurum mo nǝ, <Katɗang gurum wu kǝ mee mbii ɗe nǝ ret kǝ wu ɓam puun wur ɗe, koo nǝǝn wur shi shik, ɗangɓe wu sat nǝ, nǝ a Korban, (ɗe shii mǝnǝ nnǝ, nǝ a mǝ Naan).
Ɓe baa wu kuɗi wuu yit nwur cìn mee mbii mɓe ɓam puun wur ɗe kǝ nǝǝn wur ɗe kas.
A mɓe kám fuu ɗesǝ mo, ɓe wuu lepwoo Naan ɗee a mbii ɗebuu, kǝ mbii mo ɗes ɗe wuu cìn mo aasǝ zak.>>
Mbii Ɗe Moo Le GurumƊee a mBii Ɗebish (Nyaknkap)
Jesu waa baa pet ɗuu gurum nǝ mo, ɓe wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Wu lekom, kǝ wur kǝlǝng mbii ɗe an nsat ɗi, kǝ wur manshii nǝ ɗe zak.

Baa mee mbii ɗe gurum kǝ se mpwoo, nǝn nle kǝ gurum ɗee a mbii ɗebish (nyaknkap) nyit Naan kas, amma a mbii ɗe moo kàa pwat mpwoo gurum, a mǝnǝ moo ke le gurum ɗee a mbii ɗebish (nyaknkap) nyit Naan.>>
Katɗang gwar ɗe kǝ kom mɓe kǝlǝngpee, ɓe wu kǝleng.
Kaaɗe Jesu yool yit ɗuu gurum nǝ mo, ɓe wur dǝm ɗel nɗǝǝn lu. Ɓe jeplep wur mo tal shii sǝmpwoo mǝnǝ pǝ wur.
Jesu sat mmo nǝnee, <<Baa wun wu manshii nǝ kas zak aa? Wu man nǝ, koo a mbii ɗeɗangyi ɗe gurum se, ɓe baa nǝn mmak le gurum ɗee a mbii ɗebish (nyaknkap) nyit Naan kas.

Mɓeɗi mbii ɗe gurum se, ɓe baa nii ɗel sham a nɗǝǝn pǝtuup wur kas, amma nii ɗel sham a nɗǝǝn ɓut nwur, ɓe wu ndem kǝn nǝ nɗyes.>> Jesu satpwoo ɗese, a mbǝkǝ wur kám ɗe nǝ, baa mee mbiise mak le gurum ɗee a mbii ɗebish (nyaknkap) nyit Naan kas.
Jesu sat zak nǝnee, <<A mbii ɗe moo kàa pwat nɗǝǝn pǝtuup gurum, a moo le gurum a mbii ɗebish (nyaknkap) nyit Naan.
Mɓeɗi a nɗǝǝn pǝtuup ngurum, ɓe pan ɗebish moo pwat a ɗi. Mbii mo kaa tang mat mo, kǝ wat, kǝ tukáa, kǝ ngaa.
Kǝ tǝlǝk, kǝ yaa bǝ pǝtuup, kǝ gwampee, kǝ ciin yaasut, kǝ zuur, kǝ wat sǝm, kǝ ɗyeep kaa, kǝ dak mwen.
A mbii ɗebish ɗesi mo jir, ɗe moo pwat nɗǝǝn pǝtuup gurum, a mǝnǝ moo ke le gurum ɗee a mbii ɗebish (nyaknkap) nyit Naan.>>
Shinzeen Mee Mat
Jesu yool a peemǝnǝ zak, ɓe wur dǝm nɗǝǝn yil nTaya kǝ Sidon. Wur dǝm ɗel nɗǝǝn mee lu, ɗe baa wur rǝɓet kǝ mee gurum manpee ɗewur ɗe kas, amma jir kǝsǝ, ɓe gurum mo dǝm yap wur kat.
Kaaɗe mee mat, ɗe riin ɗebish nɗǝǝn reep war ɗelee, war kǝlǝng pwoo nkaa Jesu, ɓe abet, war jì taa ntoom wur.
Baa mat nǝ war a mat Yahudi kas, war a mat Heleni. Mo làa war a nFonisha, ɗe nǝn nyil nSiriya. War ɗang pǝ Jesu, mbǝkǝ wur ceen riin ɗebish nǝ put mɓut nreep war nǝ.
Jesu lap nwar nǝnee, <<Yi yit kǝ mu shin mbiise njeplu mo ǝɓǝl ɗi aku, mbǝɗe baa nǝ ret kǝ mu mang mbiise mǝ jep mo, kǝ mu fwo nǝn as mo kas.>>
Amma waa sat nǝ, <<Ii, nǝ aasǝ Daa, amma as nǝ moo se rep pak mbiise ɗe nii ɗong nyil, nder peetong mǝ sese jeplu nǝ mo.>>
Jesu sat nwar nǝnee, <<Mbǝ pwoo ɗe yi sat sǝ, ɓe yi dǝm ntul wur-wur, riin ɗebish nǝ kǝ put mɓut nreep fii nǝ.>>
Kaaɗe mat nǝ war baa ntul far, ɓe war kat reep war nsaam nkaa mbiisaam. Riin ɗebish nǝ kǝ put nɗǝǝn reep nǝ jee.
Jesu Bar Mee Tǝding
Jesu yool yit yil nTaya, ɓe wur taa mer nSidon, ɓe wur jì wul am kuur mǝ Galili, nkwang nyil nDikapolis.
Mee des mo jì kǝ mee tǝding, ɗe baa wur mak leshap kas pee Jesu ɗe. Mo ɗang pǝ wur, kǝ wur lesar wur ɗi nkaa tǝding nǝ.
Mɓut ɗuu gurum nǝ mo, ɓe Jesu yaa tǝding nǝ nsar, dǝm kǝ wur mee kwang coot mbǝshin. Jesu jwal nǝkongsar fin mo nɗǝǝn kom gwar nǝ, kǝ wur ɓwet lii, ɓe wu tung liis gwar nǝ zak.
Jesu naapee kaa aɗeng, ɗangɓe wur nook puut, ɓe wur sat ntǝding nǝ shi lǝpwoo mu nenyil Arameek mo nǝnee, <<Iffata>> ɗe shii kǝ mǝnǝ nǝ, <<Wang!>>
Ɓe abet, ɓe gwar nǝ kǝlǝngpee, kǝ liis nwur nǝ fween, ɓe wur leshap rǝret.
Jesu satpwoo ngurum nǝ mo shiɓal nǝ, taji mo satpwoo nkaa nǝ mmee gurum kas, amma a koppee ɗe mon nɗok tǝtǝk, ɓe mo waa dǝm satpwoo ngurum mo nkaa nǝ ɗes.
Nǝ aapwoo ngurum nǝ mo hakyeng, ɗangɓe mo sat nǝnee, <<Wur cìn mbii mo jir a ndǝre-ndǝre. Wur le kǝ komjoor mo kǝlǝngpee, kǝ tǝding mo leshap zak.>>
